description: F7: bring the LLM chat path to parity with the deterministic path. (a) llmGateway resolves the analysis target via resolveAnalysisTarget so an attached file/preview is analyzed instead of the active sheet; (b) buildAdaptiveContext/buildReferencedSheetEncodings read referenced non-active sheets through the sheet-ID-scoped getSheetComputedValue instead of the active-sheet getComputedValue; (c) the sample-row preview preserves real sheet row addresses instead of renumbering retained rows as Row 1,2,3; plus one focused Vitest parity test. Independent of FEAT-002 (different file). Reference implementation is deterministicDispatcher.ts + analysisTarget.ts — match it, do not invent.
steps: src/ai/adaptiveContext.ts: add `getSheetComputedValue: (sheetId: string, row: number, col: number) => string` to AdaptiveContextOptions; destructure it in buildAdaptiveContext; change buildReferencedSheetEncodings to take getSheetComputedValue (instead of getComputedValue) and inside its `for (const { sheet } of referenced)` loop call compressSheet(sheet, (row, col) => getSheetComputedValue(sheet.id, row, col), {...}). Leave active-sheet paths (buildSpreadsheetContext, compressSheet(activeSheet, getComputedValue, ...), tight-compress branch, drop-to-[] branch) unchanged.

src/ai/pipeline/stages/llmGateway.ts: import resolveAnalysisTarget from '@/ai/analysisTarget'; at the start of process() resolve `const target = resolveAnalysisTarget({ workbook: context.workbook, sheet: context.sheet, selection: context.selection, getComputedValue: context.getComputedValue, getSheetComputedValue: context.getSheetComputedValue, attachedPreview: context.attachedPreview })`; call buildAdaptiveContext({ tokenBudget, workbook: target.workbook, activeSheet: target.sheet, selection: context.selection, getComputedValue: target.getComputedValue, getSheetComputedValue: target.getSheetComputedValue }); switch the audit call to runAudit(target.sheet, target.getComputedValue); read hasMultipleSheets/sheetNames in getContextualSuggestions from target.workbook.sheets.

src/ai/buildContext.ts: change buildSampleRows to also return the real 0-based sheet row index for each retained row; add optional `sampleRowIndices?: number[]` to SpreadsheetContextPayload; populate it in buildSpreadsheetContext's return alongside sampleRows. Keep sampleRows as string[][] so existing consumers are untouched.

server/src/prompt.ts: add optional `sampleRowIndices?: number[]` to SpreadsheetContextInput; in the Priority-7 sample-rows block render `Row ${(context.sampleRowIndices?.[i] ?? i) + 1}` instead of `Row ${i + 1}`.

Add src/ai/pipeline/__tests__/llmGatewayParity.test.ts (Vitest; mock @/ai/agentClient like llmGateway.test.ts; do NOT mock @/ai/buildContext or @/ai/analysisTarget). Case (a): active sheet has a marker value, attachedPreview wraps a different workbook with a distinct marker — assert captured chatWithAgentServerStream context.workbookName reflects the attached file and the payload reflects attached data, not the active sheet. Case (b): 2-sheet workbook, active sheet references a second sheet; getSheetComputedValue returns correct values only when keyed by the second sheet id while active-only getComputedValue would return wrong values — assert the referenced-sheet encoding reflects the sheet-scoped values. If the existing llmGateway.test.ts makeContext needs getSheetComputedValue to typecheck, add it to that helper's defaults.

If needed for typecheck, add getSheetComputedValue to the makeContext default in src/ai/pipeline/__tests__/llmGateway.test.ts (resolveAnalysisTarget treats it as optional, so existing assertions still hold with no attachedPreview).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` (root) passes with the new getSheetComputedValue parameter threaded through every call site.
`npm run build --prefix server` passes with the SpreadsheetContextInput.sampleRowIndices addition.
`npx vitest run src/ai/pipeline/__tests__/llmGateway.test.ts` passes (existing LLM-gateway tests unbroken).

`npx vitest run src/ai/pipeline/__tests__/llmGatewayParity.test.ts` passes, and the new test fails if llmGateway reverts to ignoring attachedPreview or adaptiveContext reverts to the active-sheet accessor.
Deterministic-path behavior is unchanged (no edits to deterministicDispatcher.ts or analysisTarget.ts logic).
verification: npx vitest run src/ai src/services shared
findings:
Implemented and verified. New parity test: src/ai/pipeline/__tests__/llmGatewayParity.test.ts (2 cases). Files changed: src/ai/adaptiveContext.ts (getSheetComputedValue threaded into AdaptiveContextOptions + buildReferencedSheetEncodings now compresses each referenced sheet with (row,col)=>getSheetComputedValue(sheet.id,row,col)); src/ai/pipeline/stages/llmGateway.ts (resolves target via resolveAnalysisTarget at top of process(); adaptive context, runAudit, and contextual-suggestions hasMultipleSheets/sheetNames all read from the resolved target); src/ai/buildContext.ts (buildSampleRows now returns {rows,indices}; added optional sampleRowIndices?: number[] to SpreadsheetContextPayload and populated it; sampleRows stays string[][]); server/src/prompt.ts (added optional sampleRowIndices?: number[] to SpreadsheetContextInput; Priority-7 renders `Row ${(context.sampleRowIndices?.[i] ?? i)+1}`); src/ai/pipeline/__tests__/llmGateway.test.ts (added getSheetComputedValue: () => '' to makeContext defaults for typecheck). No other call sites touched (buildAdaptiveContext has one real caller, llmGateway).

Sanity check done: with llmGateway reverted to ignore attachedPreview, case (a) fails; with buildReferencedSheetEncodings reverted to the active-sheet accessor, case (b) fails. Both restored. Case (b) note: the SpreadsheetLLM compressor renders formula text (not computed values) in structural/lossless modes, and buildReferencedSheetEncodings uses mode:'structural' (no format-aggregation), so a referenced formula cell with an EMPTY stored value only survives compression when the computed-value accessor returns non-empty for it. The test exploits exactly that: the active-only getComputedValue returns '' for Sheet2 (collapsing it to {"empty": true}) while the sheet-id-scoped getSheetComputedValue returns a real value, keeping Sheet2's cells in the encoding. If a later feature switches referenced sheets to mode:'full', the sampleValue in the [regions] block would also distinguish the accessors.

Environment note for later steps: this worktree had no server/node_modules; I ran `npm install --prefix server` (matched the existing lockfile, no package-lock.json change) so `npm run build --prefix server` and `npm run test --prefix server` could run. All 5 verification commands pass (root typecheck 0; server build 0; client vitest 521 passed; server vitest 496 passed; lint:ci 0). FEAT-002 (persona.ts reword, plan step 5) was intentionally NOT touched.
